_description: Corrected enrichment examples for enrich_items.py. Loaded at --prepare time and injected into enrichment_input.json as a feedback_context block so Claude can learn from past corrections without re-enriching already-done items.
_inject_instructions: When you see an object with _type=feedback_context in enrichment_input.json, read these examples before enriching the items. Apply the same patterns, groupings, and naming conventions shown here.

examples._note: ADD CORRECTED EXAMPLES HERE AS THE PROJECT PROGRESSES

_format.lesson: the generalised rule to apply to future similar items

grouping_rules.detail: FG (friction grip), RA (right angle / slow-speed), and HP (handpiece / straight) burs are ALWAYS separate Shopify products even if they are the same shape and grit. Shank type determines the handpiece: a dentist ordering FG burs cannot use RA burs.
Even if two burs look identical, if one is Komet and one is Diatech they must be separate Shopify products. Brand provenance matters for ordering and quality assurance.

grouping_rules.rule: Generic / unknown vendor items cannot be grouped
grouping_rules.detail: If the brand field is blank or 'Generic', treat as unknown manufacturer. Do not group with any named brand. Give it a standalone Shopify product.

variant_naming_rules.rule: COPY STYLE (enforced): no em dashes (U+2014) or en dashes (U+2013) in ANY customer-facing field: enriched_title, shopify_collection, option names/values, tags, description_html. Trailing qualifiers use parentheses or a comma; compound values use a comma or space; numeric ranges use the word 'to'. Plain hyphens inside real product names (Integra-CP, Butter-Soft) are fine. No exclamation points. No filler adjectives (premium, high-quality, world-class, seamless): state the spec instead.
Use clinical option names, never Option 1 / Option 2 / Config
Avoid ' / ' in option names (Shopify rejects it); use '&' instead

lessons_log.lesson: feedback/enrichment_examples.json created. Add corrected examples here as issues are identified through the Fix Tracker sheet or manual review.

Em dashes were appearing on the live Shopify store (112 titles, 44 option values, 21 descriptions) because the enrichment SOP itself recommended the em dash as an option-value separator. Rule reversed: no em/en dashes in any customer-facing copy. Enforced three ways: (1) this rules block is injected into every enrichment batch, (2) enrich_items.py --write scrubs violations deterministically (scrub_dashes in common.py), (3) validate_enrichment.py Rule 7b fails any survivor. Live-store remediation of existing dashes tracked separately.
